raw:
@q query
  where match
    relation "be on"
    role subject "Silviu Rădulescu"
    role object "Șoimii din Craiova"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "own"
    role subject "Silviu Rădulescu"
    role object "via"
    role location "near Sibiu"
    polarity affirmed
  end
